text:
olivia: heads up — deploy-bot flagged a checksum warning on the staging publish for service-api:pr-1234. seeing inconsistent blob checksums during push.

deploy-bot: publish aborted for registry.us-east-1.redwood-inference/internal/service-api:pr-1234 (digest mismatch). details: 
  uploaded layer 3/7, expected sha256:abcde... got sha256:abcf0...
  action=abort, reason=checksum_mismatch

sam: ugh. is this the blob reorder issue again or something different?

ryan: looks like a chunk-level checksum flip. timestamps from the build node show interrupted upload retry. not a cosign attestation error.

maya: can you paste the full error from the push logs? quick grep might show region/proxy flip.

olivia: paste from deploy-bot logs: 
```
[2025-10-18T14:12:03Z] upload chunk 3 failed: expected sha256:abcde..., got sha256:abcf0...
[2025-10-18T14:12:03Z] attempt=3 retrying
[2025-10-18T14:12:07Z] server responded with 200 but digest mismatch on finalize
```

sam: legit mismatch. could be multipart upload reassembled with out-of-order chunks by the mirror. do we have a previous successful digest to pin to?

deploy-bot: previous published digest for service-api:pr-1234 -> sha256:ff12... (staging, 2025-10-18T02:01:04Z)

ryan: ok pin to the last known-good digest on downstream registries and hold the canary. release-manager, recommend delaying the promote window.

release-manager: agree hold. cancel the EU change window for this image. we'll not promote to production until republish verified. update release notes with the hold.

maya: short-term fix: force-republish the same build artifacts from the CI cache to a new tag and run cosign verify. command I used before:
```
publishbot retry --artifact-id=ci-artefact-98765 --target-tag=staging-republish-98765 --force
cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/cosign service-api@sha256:ff12...
```

olivia: before we republish, can infra confirm no transient S3 proxy issue in us-east-1? @ryan can you check network egress logs for the build fleet between 14:11-14:13 UTC?

ryan: checking now. quick scan shows three aborted chunk uploads from build-node-17 headed to mirror-proxy-5. proxy logs show a brief 502 spike at 14:12:06 UTC.

sam: that aligns. so upload succeeded but finalize returned inconsistent digest — likely proxy corruption. plan: (1) pin current prod digest so rollout uses sha256:ff12... (2) republish from CI cache to a new tag from the same artifact (no rebuild) (3) run cosign verify + attestation attach (4) re-run canary in staging.

release-manager: approve that plan. timeline: republish within the 2hr change window we have now, but hold production promote until cosign/attestation verified end-to-end. add note to release notes: "service-api staging publish held due to checksum mismatch; republish in progress." I'll update.

maya: I'll kick the publishbot retry now and watch the logs. will ping here when cosign passes or fails.

deploy-bot: republish started for artifact ci-artefact-98765 -> staging-republish-98765. watch_url: https://publishbot.internal/redwood/ops/98765

olivia: also adding a quick postmortem checklist: check mirror-proxy health, rotate proxy node if similar 502 spikes detected, add finalization checksum assertion in publishbot to retry at finalize stage.

ryan: opened infra ticket INF-2025 to investigate proxy 502 spike and auto-remediation for mirror-proxy-5.

maya: cosign verify succeeded: service-api@sha256:ff12... verified with KMS key cosign-prod-key. attestation uploaded.

deploy-bot: republish finished, staging tag staging-republish-98765 -> sha256:ff12...
publish status: success
attestation: present

sam: canary run starting now against the republished tag. will watch latency and pull rates.

olivia: once canary passes, we'll schedule a manual promote to production outside the EU change window tomorrow morning. leaving the thread for any further regressions.

release-manager: thanks all — hold added to release notes and internal changelog. will follow up with postmortem link after INF-2025 updates. :thumbsup:
